name: get-set-reset
script:
mtc_set regex_syntax to "PCRE"
mtc_get regex_syntax
mtc_reset regex_syntax
mtc_get regex_syntax

name: set-normalizes
script:
mtc_set regex_syntax to "pcre"
mtc_get regex_syntax
mtc_set idle_timeout to 300.0
mtc_get idle_timeout
mtc_reset all_settings

name: text-names
script:
mtc_set "regex syntax" to "PERL"
mtc_get "RegexSyntax"
mtc_get "regex_syntax"
mtc_get "REGEX SYNTAX"
mtc_reset "regex syntax"

name: all-settings
script:
mtc_set idle_timeout to 0
mtc_set dollar_references to true
mtc_set regex_syntax to "JAVA"
mtc_get all_settings
mtc_reset "AllSettings"
mtc_get "all settings"

name: dollar-references-applies
script:
mtc_set dollar_references to true
change "(b)" into "[$1]" in "abc" with regexp
mtc_reset dollar_references
change "(b)" into "[$1]" in "abc" with regexp

name: regex-syntax-applies
script:
mtc_set regex_syntax to "PCRE"
find text "\\h+" in "x y" with regexp and string result
mtc_reset regex_syntax
try
find text "\\h+" in "x y" with regexp and string result
end try
